title: Core Parent Carousel System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a parent-facing education carousel system across welcome, milestones, home practice, and event reminders.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the carousel-card frame, family-trust palette, photo-to-panel balance, and blank copy hierarchy. Images 02-04 preserve the same communication system while changing the message scenario.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-welcome-carousel first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-milestone-update-carousel, 03-home-practice-carousel, 04-event-reminder-carousel. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-welcome-carousel is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
